page.overview:
What is Luna Bug?

The Luna Bug was a species native to the planet Genna, with three tentacle-like limbs and a tail. It used two tentacles in its mouth to devour its prey. One individual of the creature was hunted down by the Dek, after he killed a Bone Bison. Dek later took a fang as a wristblade replacement.
